task.title: Correct local performance acceptance cache and target semantics
task.description:
The 2026-07-29 final evaluation could not produce acceptance-conformant local mutation evidence. Fresh scenario fixtures did not seed the SQLite task projection, so first mutations included a 500-tip bootstrap while paired free/restore and burst operations mixed bootstrap and warm-cache work. The fixture also omitted required labels, dependency edges, and tombstones.

Correct workbook-bench before any durability decision. Generate deterministic 500-by-20 histories with realistic current fields, nonempty labels, dependency edges, ranks, and a controlled tombstone population. Seed the disposable projection outside every timed cold-process and warm-server mutation sample, while measuring projection bootstrap as a separate scenario. Attach executable per-scenario targets for cold single mutations at or below 200 ms, warm API update at or below 100 ms, and every ten-operation burst strictly below 1,000 ms. Preserve process counting, fixture isolation, Git durability, and existing raw evidence; record the exact source commit and binary checksum.

Acceptance: SHA-1 and SHA-256 representative 500-by-20 runs use at least 20 local samples; mutation tests prove removing either representative fixture data or the unmeasured projection seed changes the measured contract; paired scenarios no longer inherit hidden state; and generated JSON/Markdown classify every local target without manual arithmetic.
